item.title: Abuja Court Begins Hearing Suit to Block January Rollout of New Tax Law
item.description: An Abuja High Court on Monday commenced hearing a lawsuit seeking to halt the implementation of Nigeria's newly enacted tax reform laws, scheduled to take effect on January 1, 2026.The suit, filed by the Incorporated Trustees of the African Initiative for Abuse of Public Trusts, challenges the validity of four key Acts: the Nigeria Tax Act 2025, Nigeria Tax Administration Act 2025, Nigeria Revenue Service (Establishment) Act 2025, and Joint Revenue Board of Nigeria (Establishment) Act 2025.Named

item.title: ‘Tinubu unwell’ – Sowore reveals reasons for president’s European trips
item.description: Former presidential candidate Omoyele Sowore on Sunday disclosed that President Bola Tinubu is unwell and managing his health. Sowore also claimed that Senate President Godswill Akpabio is “practically dying.” He made the revelation while explaining the reason for Tinubu’s abrupt trip abroad. Tinubu, who was in Lagos State for the Christmas and New Year holiday, left Nigeria for Europe today. item.title: PDP leaders will join me – Wike addresses defecting to APC
item.description: The Minister of the Federal Capital Territory, FCT, Nyesom Wike, dismissed any possibility of dumping the Peoples Democratic Party, PDP, for the All Progressives Congress, APC. item.title: ‘It casts a deep shadow on this season’ — Tinubu wishes Anthony Joshua quick recovery after accident
item.description: President Bola Tinubu has sympathised with former world heavyweight boxing champion Anthony Joshua following a tragic accident on the Lagos–Ibadan expressway that left two persons dead. The accident occurred on Monday afternoon near the Sinoma area, close to the Sagamu axis of the expressway in Ogun state, leaving the boxing champion with minor injuries. item.title: Ogun: Joshua now conscious, he’s in communication with his family
item.description: Ogun state government says Anthony Joshua is now stable and conscious after sustaining injuries from a car accident on the Lagos-Ibadan Expressway. Joshua was involved in a motor crash that claimed two lives on Monday. The accident happened around 12 noon when the Lexus jeep Joshua was in crashed into a stationary truck near the Sinoma area on the Sagamu axis of the road.
